_comment: The single source for Anthropic model ids. Before this file there were three
lists that disagreed: ClaudeLink/ClaudeCLI.swift (picker + retired map),
(DEFAULT_MODEL). Node reads this file; Swift keeps a literal list and
`models` is the PICKER (what a user may choose, Mac-side). `chain` is the
server's metering fallback order. They are different concerns and need not
be equal -- but see the OPEN DECISION below.
OPEN DECISION: two of the three `chain` entries are keys in `retired`, i.e.
the server calls models the Mac coerces away, and `default` is one of them.
Values are left AS THE SERVER HAS THEM so this change is behaviour-neutral;
the gate REPORTS the condition rather than silently picking. Flipping the
chain to the picker's ids is a 3-line edit here plus ~12 test updates.
